class.name: IfcQuantityTime
class.brief_description: IfcQuantityTime is an element quantity that defines a time measure to provide an property of time related to an element. It is normally given by the recipe information of the element under the specific measure rules given by a method of measurement. EXAMPLE The amount of time needed to pour concrete for a wall is given as a time quantity for the labor part of the recipe information. HISTORY New en

members.member: Time measure value of this quantity.

A formula by which the quantity has been calculated. It can be assigned in addition to the actual value of the quantity. Formulas could be mathematic calculations (like width x height), database links, or a combination. The formula is for informational purposes only.
